comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A brief word about Quarters production: your aide's production rank is directly affected by two factors, their trait points (Navigator, Lookout, Paymaster, Storekeeper, Lieutenant, Surgeon) and their +1 to production skills (or lack thereof).

When you station an aide in Production mode, their rank becomes visible. Here is the formula:

Total Cumulative Trait Points = Rank as follows
001 ~ 119 = R1
120 ~ 179 = R2
180 ~ 239 = R3
240 ~ 299 = R4
300 ~ 359 = R5
360 ~ 419 = R6
420 ~ 479 = R7
480 ~ 539 = R8
540 ~ 599 = R9
600 ~ MAX = R10

The maximum value an aide can reach is R10. But it's not just Trait Points are important. While R10 may be the maximum rank that an Aide can achieve under normal conditions, if your Aide has a Production +1 Skill (Storage, Sewing, so on), then they will receive a permanent bonus of +5 to their base production rank. So if you have an aide who is r9 base rank but has +1 casting, their casting will be R14.

Thus the only way to successfully produce items in Aide Quarters Production beyond R10 is to have an aide (or aides) with +1 production skills. Cheers, and great aide producing to you.
